LanguageData.RLRG_Enable_Desc: Outsiders only arrive with gear your colony has researched.
LanguageData.RLRG_UseRecipes_Desc: An item is unlocked when the research for at least one recipe that makes it is done.
LanguageData.RLRG_BlockHigherTech: Block items above colony tech level
LanguageData.RLRG_BlockHigherTech_Desc: Items without research are only allowed up to your colony's researched tech level.
LanguageData.RLRG_BlockUntagged_Desc: Weapons and apparel from other mods with no research are treated as locked.
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterAll_Desc: Raids, visitors, caravans and quests. When off, only hostiles and attackers.
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterInventory_Desc: Weapons and apparel in the inventory (for example sidearms).
LanguageData.RLRG_Replace_Desc: A locked item is replaced with a similar allowed one, with the same quality and wear.
LanguageData.RLRG_Drop: Leave locked items on the ground
LanguageData.RLRG_Drop_Desc: Raiders carry locked items in their inventory – you get them as loot when you beat them. Visitors and traders leave nothing behind. Otherwise the locked item disappears.
LanguageData.RLRG_ExemptAncients_Desc: Their gear is part of the reward for opening them.
LanguageData.RLRG_KeepTitleApparel_Desc: Apparel required by a royal title or an ideoligion role is not removed.
LanguageData.RLRG_DamageDropped_Desc: Locked items left on the ground have only 20–50% durability and apparel is marked as worn by a corpse. Prevents easy profit from selling them.
LanguageData.RLRG_Compensate_Desc: When raiders lose part of their gear, the raid gets extra raiders so the difficulty stays balanced.
LanguageData.RLRG_CompensationPct_Desc: How much of the lost gear is made up for with extra raiders. A raid can get at most 50% more points.
LanguageData.RLRG_TechAhead_Desc: Outsiders may have items up to this many tech levels above your colony, even without research. 0 = researched items only.
LanguageData.RLRG_KeepChance: Chance to keep a locked item: {0}%
LanguageData.RLRG_KeepChance_Desc: With this chance a pawn keeps a locked item. The result is remembered, so it isn't rolled again next time.
LanguageData.RLRG_NotifyRaid_Desc: A message in the top left showing how much gear raiders lost and how many were added.
LanguageData.RLRG_Biocode_Desc: Replacement items are biocoded to their wearer, so you can't use them after the fight and they sell for less. Only works for items that support biocoding (mostly advanced weapons).
LanguageData.RLRG_Years: Unlock over time: +1 level per {0} years
LanguageData.RLRG_Years_Desc: Raiders gradually get better gear even without your research. Adds to the tech level tolerance.
LanguageData.RLRG_MsgRaidCompensated: Raiders lost {0}% of their gear. Raid reinforced with {1} extra raiders.
LanguageData.RLRG_ListHint: Checked items are never given to outsiders. Status shows what they may have right now.
LanguageData.RLRG_ListNoGame: Checked items are never given to outsiders. Load a game to see the current status.
LanguageData.RLRG_Ex_NoResearch: No research (tech level and the mod item rule decide)
LanguageData.RLRG_TechMismatch: Check items more advanced than their research
LanguageData.RLRG_TechMismatch_Desc: When a mod puts an advanced item under lower research (a spacer rifle under industrial research), the colony must also reach that item's tech level.
LanguageData.RLRG_PowerEstimate: Estimate mod item tech level from power
LanguageData.RLRG_PowerEstimate_Desc: A mod weapon or armor clearly stronger than the best vanilla industrial one counts as spacer, even if the mod author set a lower level. This is an estimate.
LanguageData.RLRG_LevelByProgress_Desc: The colony reaches a tech level once it has finished the set share of that level's research. Off = the highest finished research decides (a single one is enough). The scenario level always counts as a minimum.
LanguageData.RLRG_LevelProgress: Required share of a level's research: {0}%
LanguageData.RLRG_LevelProgress_Desc: How much of a level's research must be finished for the colony to count as that level.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldRaids: Raids only from factions up to world level
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldRaids_Desc: Factions more advanced than the world level (your level + tolerance) can't send raids. Exempt factions from the list below are not limited.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldMechs_Desc: By default mechanoids and insects are not limited. When on, mechanoid raids and mech clusters won't come until the world reaches their level.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldItems: Traders, rewards and loot up to world level
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldItems_Desc: Items above world level are removed from trader stock, quest rewards and loot. Weapons and apparel follow the same rules as outsiders' gear.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldIncidents_Desc: Ship part crashes, ship chunks, orbital traders and (with mechanoids) mech clusters won't happen until the world reaches their level.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldUp: The world advanced to tech level: {0}.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldQuests_Desc: Random storyteller quests involving a faction more advanced than the world (attacker, ally, quest giver) are silently dropped. Quests tied to advanced tech (archotech, gravships, with mechanoids also mech quests) are not offered. Rewards follow research like traders. Story quests and ceremonies are never blocked.
LanguageData.RLRG_ManualLevel_Desc: The world level isn't calculated from research; the one you pick applies exactly, without tolerance or unlock over time.
LanguageData.RLRG_PerTier_Desc: Set separately for each level how much of its research must be finished.
LanguageData.RLRG_LockResearch_Desc: Research more than one level above the world can't be started. You have to advance level by level.
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterPossessions: Other inventory items above world level
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterPossessions_Desc: Arrivals also lose medicine, drugs, components and other items above world level (for traders this includes their goods).
LanguageData.RLRG_ReplaceQuests_Desc: Instead of a quest dropped because of the world level, the storyteller immediately tries another suitable one (up to 5 attempts). Quests come as often as usual.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldVisitors: Caravans and visitors only up to world level (strict)
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldVisitors_Desc: Trader caravans, visitors and travelers only come from factions up to the world level. WARNING: with modded spacer factions almost no traders may come. When off (recommended), they come from all factions, but their goods and gear are filtered by world level.
LanguageData.RLRG_ReplaceEvents: Replace a blocked event with a random one
LanguageData.RLRG_ReplaceEvents_Desc: When the storyteller picks an event the world isn't ready for (orbital trader, ship part crash, ship chunks…), or a raid or caravan finds no suitable faction, a random other event of the same category fires instead. Events come as often as without the mod. Quest events are not changed.
LanguageData.RLRG_OvEventsHint: The storyteller picks events randomly, so the exact time of the next one can't be known. The estimate is based on the average gap between events in this game and gets better the longer you play.
LanguageData.RLRG_OvNoEvents: Nothing recorded yet. Recording starts with this version.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldCausers: Threats above world level don't stay
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldCausers_Desc: New things that put a condition on the map (toxic spewer, smoke, weather controller, sun blocker, psychic droner…) above the world level are removed right away – on the map and the world map, even if they belong to mechanoids. Quests that would send such a thing are dropped (storyteller quests are replaced). What already stands stays.
LanguageData.RLRG_CauserBlocked: A threat above the world level did not stay: {0}.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderGuarantee_Desc: If no trader caravan reaches the home colony for a long time, the mod tries to call one. The game then also accepts factions that would otherwise not travel in this temperature. If a caravan cannot come (everyone hostile, blocking group on the map…), the reason is written to the log and a message is shown.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderGuaranteeDays: Caravan at the latest after: {0} days
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderGuaranteeDays_Desc: After how many days without a caravan the mod calls one.
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_Open: Why don't traders, visitors or threats come?
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_LastTraderNone: Last trader caravan: none recorded yet
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_GuaranteeOn: Trader guarantee: on (at the latest after {0} days)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_NoAllies: All factions are hostile – the storyteller sends no traders or visitors. Improve relations (gifts, quests, comms console).
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_R_NoFaction: no faction can come now (see faction list)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_R_OnlyDesperate: storyteller won't send it – factions won't travel in this temperature
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_F_Desperate: only when desperate – outdoor temperature outside {0}
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_F_Lord: its enemy is on the map: {0}
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_F_World: above world level (option "Caravans and visitors only up to world level")
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_F_Other: other reason (trader kind, planet layer or another mod)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_GuaranteeFailed: Trader guarantee: a caravan could not come ({0}). Details: World tab → Why don't traders come?
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_ThreatScale: Difficulty: threat scale {0}, big threats allowed: {1}
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_ThreatsOff: WARNING: threats are disabled in the storyteller difficulty – that is why no raids come.
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_LastThreatNone: Last storyteller threat: none recorded yet
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_AboveWorld: above world level – replaced by another event
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_RaidWorld: above world level – raids only when nobody else can (gear is filtered)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_RaidDesperate: only when desperate (temperature / early after settling)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_RaidNo: cannot raid (planet layer, strategy or another mod)
LanguageData.RLRG_Diag_NoRaiders: No hostile faction can send a raid now – there are no hostile factions, or something else blocks all of them.
LanguageData.RLRG_FactionsAtWorld: All factions at your colony's level
LanguageData.RLRG_FactionsAtWorld_Desc: All factions (including spacer and modded ones) act as if they had the same research as you: they can raid, trade, visit and give quests, but every one of their people only has gear you have researched (always filtered, for all arrivals), and traders only sell items up to the world level. Turn off to block factions above the world level completely.
LanguageData.RLRG_OnlyCrafted: Others only use what you have crafted
LanguageData.RLRG_OnlyCrafted_Desc: Raiders, visitors, traders and quest pawns may only have weapons and apparel your colony has already crafted at least once (and researched). Anything not crafted yet is removed or replaced with the closest crafted item. With no crafted weapon they get at least a short bow or a club. Goods for sale follow research only. In an ongoing game, colonists' gear and stored items you can craft are taken over once.
LanguageData.RLRG_CraftedCount: Crafted kinds of weapons and apparel: {0}
LanguageData.RLRG_MsgCraftedNew: Crafted for the first time: {0} – others can use it now too.
LanguageData.RLRG_Ex_NotCrafted: Researched, but your colony has not crafted it yet.
LanguageData.RLRG_CraftedReset_Desc: Clears the list of crafted weapons and apparel (shared with Smart Colonist Gear). From now on only what the colony crafts counts.
LanguageData.RLRG_CraftedResetConfirm: Really clear the crafted gear list? It is cleared in both mods and raiders and colonists may only use gear crafted from now on.
LanguageData.RLRG_MsgRaidItems: {0} pieces of gear taken, {1} replaced with a weaker version ({2} raiders).
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderTechBonus_Desc: How many tech levels above the world level traders may offer goods. 0 = only up to world level (weapons and apparel by research), 1 = one level higher (e.g. industrial guns in a medieval game) …
LanguageData.RLRG_TabTraders_Desc: Goods that traders may not sell right now because they are above the world level. Uses the same rule as trader stock.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderNoGame: Load a game to see what traders may not sell right now.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderOff: The world items filter is off – traders sell everything.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderMax: Traders may sell goods up to: {0} (world level {1} + {2})
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderMax_Desc: Traders may sell goods up to the tech level {0} (world level + "Traders may sell levels higher"). Weapons and apparel may also be sold when they are allowed by research. Animals, slaves and goods without a tech level are never removed.
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderCount: Goods traders may not sell now: {0}
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderBlocked_Desc: Tech level {0} is above what traders may sell now ({1}).
LanguageData.RLRG_TraderBlockedGear_Desc: Not allowed by research, and tech level {0} is above what traders may sell now ({1}).
LanguageData.RLRG_RaidsIntro: Unchecked raids and threats (also from mods: monsters, manhunters, insects, diseases, fallout …) will not happen. Checked = allowed. Changes apply to new raids right away.
LanguageData.RLRG_RaidsResetAll_Desc: Allow every raid type again (the default).
LanguageData.RLRG_RaidsAllowAll_Desc: Allow everything in this group again.
LanguageData.RLRG_RaidsAllowedTip: Allowed. Uncheck to stop this from happening.
LanguageData.RLRG_RaidsBlockedTip: Blocked: the storyteller will not use this. If every option a raid could use is blocked, the raid falls back to an immediate attack / walking in from the map edge instead of failing.
LanguageData.RLRG_MechEscorts: Raiders bring only mechanoids you have researched
LanguageData.RLRG_MechEscorts_Desc: Human factions (mechanitors in raids) may only bring mechanoids whose gestation you have researched. Unresearched mechs are removed from the group. Pure mechanoid raids are not affected.
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchColony: Arrivals carry nothing better than your colony's gear
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchColony_Desc: Everyone who arrives (raiders, visitors, refugees, quest pawns; traders only when not skipped) may only carry gear equal to or weaker than the best your colony has crafted: guns up to your best crafted gun, melee weapons up to your best crafted one (material counts), armor up to your best crafted armor. Ordinary clothes are always fine. Gear must also be truly researched (you must be able to craft it). Fire, explosive and EMP weapons (flamethrowers, explosive arrows…) only once you have crafted that weapon yourself. Better gear is replaced by the closest weaker one, too-good material by ordinary material. Together with "only crafted", weaker gear you never crafted is allowed too – more variety.
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchQuality: Quality at most your best product
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchQuality_Desc: Weapons and apparel of arrivals are at most the quality your colony has crafted (separately for weapons and apparel, at least normal).
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchMargin_Desc: How many percent better than yours the gear of others may be. 0 = equal at most.
LanguageData.RLRG_MatchNow: Cap now – guns: {0}, melee: {1}, armor: {2}, weapon quality: {3}, apparel quality: {4}
LanguageData.RLRG_ShowHud_Desc: Bottom right above the date: the colony level and how far the next level is. Hover for details per level, click to open the World tab.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.RLRG_Rec1: Raiders only carry gear of your tech level
LanguageData.RLRG_Rec2: Traders sell items of your level
LanguageData.RLRG_Rec3: Quests and rewards match your level
LanguageData.RLRG_Rec5: Weaker raider gear is balanced by more raiders
LanguageData.RLRG_Rec6: The world level is shown on screen
LanguageData.RLRG_RareAdvanced_Desc: With this chance a raid brings gear one tech level above your colony. There are fewer raiders (25% fewer points) and their gear stays as loot, so you can discover new tech early. Only when the raiding faction has such gear.
LanguageData.RLRG_RareLowTech_Desc: With this chance a raid brings gear one tech level below your colony, but with more raiders (35% more points).
LanguageData.RLRG_MsgRareAdvanced: The raiders carry unknown technology ({0})! There are fewer of them, but they are better armed.
LanguageData.RLRG_MsgRareLowTech: A large raid with outdated gear ({0}).
LanguageData.RLRG_StrictCrafted: Strict: only what you crafted, also when matching the colony
LanguageData.RLRG_StrictCrafted_Desc: "Match the colony" normally allows anything about as strong as your gear. With this on, enemies may only carry weapons and apparel your colony has actually crafted – no makeshift rifles or SMGs while you still use bows.
LanguageData.RLRG_SiteTurrets: Enemy turrets only up to your own
LanguageData.RLRG_SiteTurrets_Desc: Turrets of other factions – on quest sites, in bases, in sieges – are removed unless you have built a turret of the same tech level yourself. No turrets yet = no enemy turrets.
LanguageData.RLRG_Gradual_Desc: When the world level goes up, at first only about 1 in 5 arrivals gets gear of the new era; the share grows evenly until everyone has it. No sudden jump.
LanguageData.RLRG_GradualDays_Desc: How many in-game days it takes until all arrivals carry gear of the new era.
LanguageData.RLRG_OutManual: Manual world level ({0}) – the outlook only works with the level from research.
LanguageData.RLRG_OutTop: Your colony is at the top tier ({0}) – nothing more to unlock.
LanguageData.RLRG_OutNext: Next tier: {0} – {1} more research projects ({2} of the {3} needed, {4} in this tier).
LanguageData.RLRG_OutGuns: New weapons for arrivals: {0} kinds, e.g. {1}
LanguageData.RLRG_OutArmor: New armor and apparel for arrivals: {0} kinds, e.g. {1}
LanguageData.RLRG_OutTraders: Traders can carry goods up to: {0}
LanguageData.RLRG_OutGradual: Gradual change of era is on – the new gear spreads over {0} days.
LanguageData.RLRG_OutGradualNow: Change of era in progress: {0} % of arrivals already have the new era's gear.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldLetter: Letter when the world reaches a higher level
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldLetter_Desc: When the world level rises you get a letter that explains it, instead of a short message. Drops are still shown as a message.
LanguageData.RLRG_WorldLetterText: The world has reached the {0} tech level.\n\nFrom now on raiders, traders and visitors may bring weapons, apparel and other goods up to this level. See the mod settings (World tab) for what the next tier brings.
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterImplants: Raiders' implants follow the world level
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterImplants_Desc: Hostile pawns don't get bionic, archotech or other implants above the world level. They are simply not installed – no missing body parts.
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterDrugs: Raiders' drugs follow the world level
LanguageData.RLRG_FilterDrugs_Desc: Hostile pawns don't carry go-juice, yayo and other drugs above the world level, so they can't take them before the fight.
LanguageData.RLRG_ResearchCost_Desc: Research above the world level costs more, research below it costs less. Off by default.
LanguageData.RLRG_ResearchAbove_Desc: How much more research of a higher tech level than the world costs.
LanguageData.RLRG_ResearchBelow_Desc: How much less research of a lower tech level than the world costs.
